turns.text: hi, my rent shows unpaid but I paid last Friday
Happy to check. Can you confirm the unit number on the account?
4B, Parkview
Thanks. I see a payment of $1,450.00 received 2026-08-08 that posted this morning. Your balance is $0.00.
ok great, thanks
no hot water since yesterday morning
I'm sorry about that. Is it the whole unit, or just one fixture?
whole apartment, and I have a newborn here
I've opened an emergency work order, WO-88214, and flagged it for same-day dispatch. A technician will call you at 972-555-0188.
please hurry
what's this $85 water charge? my bill is usually $40
Your August statement shows a water and sewer allocation of $84.12 for the July 1 to July 31 period, up from $41.30 in July. Usage for the building rose during the heat wave.
so it's not a mistake?
It is not an error, but if you would like it reviewed I can open a billing inquiry.
no that's fine
I was charged an NSF fee but my bank says the transfer cleared
I see a $35.00 returned payment fee posted 2026-08-12. Do you have the confirmation number from your bank?
Thank you. I've opened dispute D-2291 with that reference and routed it to the property accountant. You'll hear back within two business days.
cuando vence mi contrato?
Su contrato de arrendamiento termina el 30 de noviembre de 2026. La notificación de renovación se envía 60 días antes.
y si quiero renovar por un año más?
Puede solicitar la renovación desde el portal del residente. La oficina le enviará las opciones disponibles.
need to change my number, new one is 214-555-0147
I can update that. To confirm, should I replace the number ending in 0102 with 214-555-0147?
yes
Updated. Your contact phone is now 214-555-0147.
this is the third time I've reported the AC and nobody has come
I'm sorry, that shouldn't happen. I see work orders WO-87551 and WO-87994, both still open.
so what are you going to do about it
I'm escalating to the property manager now and requesting a call back today. Would you like me to stay on while I do that?
just have someone call me
attaching my August bill, the circled charge doesn't look right
Thanks. I can see a circle around the pest control line, $12.00, dated 2026-08-01. Is that the charge you're asking about?
yes, I never signed up for pest control
Pest control is a community-wide service listed in section 7 of your lease. I've opened billing inquiry B-4410 so the office can review it with you.
